response.justification: The candidate meets the minimum bar with roughly 19 years of hands-on software engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems, plus genuine entrepreneurial experience as founder of an open-source platform. However, the role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, and the resume shows only recent, early-stage AI exposure (MCP tooling and agentic workflows since 2025), no advanced degree in an AI-related field, no recognized AI thought leadership, and no track record of shipping AI products at scale or advising strategic customers. The profile reads as a strong senior/staff full-stack engineer rather than a principal-level AI strategist.
strengths: 19+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and infrastructure
Entrepreneurial track record as founder of GISCollective, an open-source geo-data platform
Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
concerns: AI experience is recent and shallow relative to the 'recognized AI expertise' expectation of the role
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, only bachelor's degrees
No evidence of director-level scope: strategic advisory, org-wide influence, or driving large-scale technical strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise and AI product track record
Exceeds 15-year experience requirement with broad technical range
Seniority mismatch — senior IC background vs. director-level strategy role
